system_description.narrative_title: Post-midterm political fallout, probes and geopolitical shocks
system_description.narrative_summary: The news window is dominated by a single narrative in which U.S. midterm outcomes catalyze intensified political investigations and legal threats, while concurrent Middle East kinetic events and intelligence allegations raise geopolitical and national-security risks. Those political and security shocks feed into regulatory scrutiny of tech and corporate leaders and into market volatility (tech selloff, energy and crypto pressures), creating reinforcing feedbacks between politics, security, corporate governance and markets.
system_description.scope: Inside: U.S. post-midterm political dynamics (investigations, impeachment threats, party strategy), legal and regulatory probes of corporations and tech leaders, national-security incidents and strikes in the Middle East (Iran, Houthi actions, Saudi targets), market responses (equities, tech/AI sector, energy, crypto), and related corporate governance news.
system_description.super_system: Global geopolitical-economic system (international security, trade and capital flows)
adjacent_subsystems: Global energy markets and supply chains
Technology and AI innovation + governance ecosystem
International financial markets and investor sentiment
evidence_headlines: Democrats vow to impeach Trump officials and investigate Republican donors
Exclusive | U.S. Strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island as Trump Talks Down War Risks

Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy

variables.name: Political investigations
variables.description: Measures the intensity and scale of investigative activity targeting public officials, campaigns and political donors.

variables.name: Legal threat rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency of lawsuits, subpoenas, indictments, impeachment threats and other formal legal actions.

variables.name: Regulatory scrutiny
variables.description: Measures the strictness, breadth and salience of regulatory oversight applied to sectors and corporate conduct.

variables.name: Regulatory enforcement rate
variables.description: Measures the tempo of enforcement interventions, investigations opened, fines levied and formal regulatory actions.

variables.name: Geopolitical kinetic incident rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency and intensity of armed strikes, missile launches, maritime incidents and other kinetic security events abroad.

variables.name: National-security risk perception
variables.description: Measures public, policymaker and market perceptions of national-security threat levels and vulnerability.

variables.name: Intelligence-allegation rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency and prominence of claims about espionage, foreign agents, leaks or intelligence compromise.

variables.name: Market volatility level
variables.description: Measures realized and implied volatility across equity, credit and broader financial markets.

variables.name: Tech-sector sentiment
variables.description: Measures investor and market sentiment specific to technology, AI and high-growth sectors.

variables.name: Corporate-governance pressure
variables.description: Measures intensity of shareholder activism, board scrutiny, public criticism and governance-related demands on corporate leaders.

variables.name: Capital-flow volatility
variables.description: Measures variability and reversals in cross-border portfolio and institutional capital movements.

variables.name: Energy supply disruption
variables.description: Measures the magnitude and duration of interruptions to production, refining or transport capacity in energy markets.

variables.name: Crypto-market stress
variables.description: Measures liquidity shortages, price dislocations and counterparty strain in cryptocurrency and digital-asset markets.

variables.name: Investor confidence
variables.description: Measures aggregated investor willingness to accept risk, allocate to equities and sustain market positions.

variables.name: Political polarization
variables.description: Measures ideological distance, partisan antagonism and the degree of cross-party cooperation breakdown.

variables.name: Media scandal coverage
variables.description: Measures volume, prominence and intensity of media reporting devoted to political and corporate scandals.

catalysts.title: Democratic probes of tech and corporate America
catalysts.description: Congressional and committee investigations targeting tech executives, platforms and corporate donors ramp up after the midterms.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Democrats plan probes of Musk, Miller, corporate America' and 'Democratic senator demands tech firms, FCC chair turn over documents.'

catalysts.title: Impeachment efforts targeting Trump officials
catalysts.description: Democratic threats to pursue impeachment and related inquiries into Trump-era officials escalate into formal actions and high-profile hearings.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Democrats vow to impeach Trump officials' and 'Hegseth Mounts Aggressive Campaign to Fight Pending Impeachment.'

catalysts.title: Nvidia board probe into CEO relationship
catalysts.description: Nvidia's board investigation of the CEO's relationship with an alleged foreign spy could produce revelations, board action or leadership change.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Nvidia’s board will probe CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with an alleged spy' and 'Nvidia investigates CEO ... as he admits affair.'

catalysts.title: Renewed Houthi strikes and Gulf incidents
catalysts.description: Ongoing Houthi missile/drone attacks and naval incidents in the Gulf region risk further strikes, retaliatory actions and wider escalation.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Houthi attack damages Aramco building' and 'US military says it disabled cargo vessel in Gulf of Oman.'

catalysts.title: Possible progress in U.S.–Iran talks
catalysts.description: Diplomatic engagement could reduce immediate strike risks and de‑escalate Gulf tensions if talks advance.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Trump says renewed Iran strikes ‘highly unlikely’ if talks progress' and reporting on US–Iran incidents.

catalysts.title: Crypto industry reckoning and regulatory actions
catalysts.description: Investigations, regulatory pressure and exchange closures related to midterm links and hacks drive liquidity stress and enforcement risk for crypto.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Crypto industry braces for reckoning over Trump ties' and 'Binance EU closures add to crypto market pressure.'

catalysts.title: Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi with European participation
catalysts.description: Diplomatic talks involving Europeans in Abu Dhabi may shape ceasefire, logistics or negotiations affecting the Ukraine conflict's trajectory.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Europeans will join Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi, French foreign minister says.'
